residual_unowned_loop: For each SourceMargin candidate: evaluate marketplace/IP risk and product/category complexity -> construct one Professional Capability Manifest for only the material professional disciplines -> bind qualified existing specialists/reviewers when available -> return READY/CONDITIONAL/BLOCKED plus exact missing capability. Policy/IP is always screened before publication. Product/category specification becomes gating only when risk triggers such as fitment/compatibility, safety/regulatory claims, electrical/electronic function, material/chemical performance, medical/health claims, vehicle fitment, load-bearing/structural claims, branded-equivalence, or other technically material equivalence are present. No generic specialist may silently certify those cases.
